title: "Fire effects on forest birds: guilds and species"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressMessages({library(dplyr); library(readr)})
```

**Design.** Forest zones only (NSW coast + escarpment, East Gippsland). Burnt = site at least 2 km inside the
2019–20 fire extent; unburnt = at least 2 km outside; sites within 2 km of the fire edge are dropped.
Seven forest species in three guilds: ground (Superb Lyrebird, Eastern Yellow Robin) | understorey (shrub +
midstorey) | canopy. Flame Robin is excluded (open-country bird). Eastern Yellow Robin is not in
`detections_long.csv`, so its detections are built from `birdata_raw.csv`: detected = recorded in that survey.

## Load data

```{r load}
guild_of <- c("Menura novaehollandiae" = "ground",
              "Eopsaltria australis" = "ground",
              "Malurus cyaneus" = "understorey",
              "Sericornis frontalis" = "understorey",
              "Acanthiza pusilla" = "understorey",
              "Platycercus elegans" = "canopy",
              "Colluricincla harmonica" = "canopy")
common_of <- c("Menura novaehollandiae" = "Superb Lyrebird", "Eopsaltria australis" = "Eastern Yellow Robin",
               "Malurus cyaneus" = "Superb Fairy-wren",
               "Sericornis frontalis" = "White-browed Scrubwren", "Acanthiza pusilla" = "Brown Thornbill",
               "Platycercus elegans" = "Crimson Rosella", "Colluricincla harmonica" = "Grey Shrike-thrush")
glev <- c("ground", "understorey", "canopy")
# forest zones = NSW coast + escarpment and East Gippsland (not Canberra/ACT, not inland tablelands)
is_forest <- function(lat, lon) !(lat > -35.6 & lon > 148.9 & lon < 149.4) & !(lon < 149.6 & lat > -37)

keep <- function(x) filter(x, is_forest(lat, lon), abs(fire_dist_m) >= 2000)
surveys <- read_csv("data/surveys.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |> keep() |> mutate(survey_id = as.character(survey_id))

# Eastern Yellow Robin: one row per survey, detected = 1 if recorded in that survey
eyr <- read_csv("data/birdata_raw.csv", show_col_types = FALSE, col_select = c(eventID, scientificName)) |>
  filter(grepl("^Eopsaltria australis", gsub("\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "", scientificName))) |>   # drop subgenus "(...)"
  distinct(survey_id = as.character(eventID)) |>
  mutate(detected = 1L)
eyr_det <- surveys |>
  left_join(eyr, by = "survey_id") |>
  mutate(species = "Eopsaltria australis", detected = coalesce(detected, 0L))

d <- read_csv("data/detections_long.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  keep() |>
  filter(species %in% names(guild_of)) |>
  mutate(survey_id = as.character(survey_id)) |>
  bind_rows(eyr_det) |>
  mutate(after  = as.integer(period == "after"),
         burnt  = as.integer(fire_dist_m < 0),       # fire_dist_m: signed distance to fire edge, negative = inside
         season = factor(season, levels = c("summer", "autumn", "winter", "spring")),
         site = factor(site), species = factor(species), grp = factor(guild_of[as.character(species)], glev))

d |>
  mutate(Species = common_of[as.character(species)], Guild = grp,
         cell = paste(ifelse(burnt == 1, "Burnt", "Unburnt"), period)) |>
  group_by(Guild, Species, cell) |>
  summarise(n = sprintf("%d / %d", sum(detected), n()), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cell, values_from = n) |>
  select(Guild, Species, `Burnt before`, `Burnt after`, `Unburnt before`, `Unburnt after`) |>
  arrange(Guild) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

## Habitat lost to fire (Levins model)

Binomial GLMM (logit link) with one fire effect δ per guild (the burnt × after interaction); each species has its
own baseline, before/after change, burnt/unburnt difference and season effect; random intercepts for site and
site × species. In Levins' model with habitat destruction, P = 1 − v − e/c, so the share of patches lost to fire is
v = P without fire − P with fire, both predicted for burnt sites after the fire. The unburnt sites give e/c = 1 − P*.

```{r levins}
library(lme4)
ctrl <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 1e5))
base <- "detected ~ species * after + species * burnt + species:season + (1 | site) + (1 | site:species)"
m2 <- glmer(as.formula(paste(base, "+ grp:burnt:after")), d, binomial, control = ctrl, nAGQ = 0)

# coefficient name for guild g × burnt × after (any order of the parts)
gterm <- sapply(glev, function(g) {
  nms <- names(fixef(m2))
  nms[vapply(strsplit(nms, ":"), function(x) length(x) == 3 && setequal(x, c(paste0("grp", g), "burnt", "after")), TRUE)]
})
B <- fixef(m2); V <- as.matrix(vcov(m2))
ba <- d$burnt == 1 & d$after == 1
eta <- predict(m2, re.form = NA)[ba]               # linear predictor, burnt sites after the fire
set.seed(1)
draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(2000, B[gterm], V[gterm, gterm])   # uncertainty in the guild δ

# P* = 1 - e/c (no fire); fire adds v:  P = 1 - v - e/c
#   buffer_used = v / P*             share of the way to the extinction threshold (v = P*)
#   c_needed    = (e/c) / (e/c - v)  factor by which colonisation must rise to restore P*
#   e_needed    = 1 - v / (e/c)      factor by which local extinction must fall to restore P*
mgmt_one <- function(g, delta) {
  i <- d$grp[ba] == g
  Pstar <- mean(plogis(eta[i] - B[[gterm[[g]]]]))
  v <- Pstar - mean(plogis(eta[i] - B[[gterm[[g]]]] + delta))
  ec <- 1 - Pstar
  c(Pstar = Pstar, v = v, e_over_c = ec, buffer_used = v / Pstar, c_needed = ec / (ec - v), e_needed = 1 - v / ec)
}
mgmt <- bind_rows(lapply(glev, function(g) {
  est  <- mgmt_one(g, B[[gterm[[g]]]])
  sims <- t(apply(draws, 1, function(x) mgmt_one(g, x[[gterm[[g]]]])))
  data.frame(guild = g, quantity = names(est), est = est,
             lo = apply(sims, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi = apply(sims, 2, quantile, 0.975))
}))
knitr::kable(mgmt, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r habitat-figure, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.4}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
gcol <- c(ground = "#8C6D31", understorey = "#C0392B", canopy = "#1F3A5F")
lab  <- function(x) tools::toTitleCase(x)
fmt  <- function(x, d = 2) gsub("-", "\u2212", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
theme_fp <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey25"))

w <- tidyr::pivot_wider(mgmt, id_cols = guild, names_from = quantity, values_from = c(est, lo, hi)) |>
  mutate(guild = factor(lab(guild), lab(glev)))                       # first level at the bottom: canopy on top
bars <- bind_rows(transmute(w, guild, part = "Occupied after fire", value = est_Pstar - pmax(est_v, 0)),
                  transmute(w, guild, part = "Lost to fire (v)",    value = pmax(est_v, 0))) |>
  mutate(part = factor(part, c("Lost to fire (v)", "Occupied after fire")),
         fillkey = ifelse(part == "Lost to fire (v)", "lost", tolower(as.character(guild))))

p1 <- ggplot(bars, aes(value, guild)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = fillkey, group = part), width = 0.6, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = w, aes(y = guild, xmin = est_Pstar - hi_v, xmax = est_Pstar - lo_v),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(gcol, lost = "grey80"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.45), breaks = seq(0, 0.4, 0.1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of surveys with a detection, P", y = NULL) +
  theme_fp + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"))

cols <- list("P* (no fire)" = fmt(w$est_Pstar),
             "v (95% CI)" = sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", fmt(w$est_v), fmt(w$lo_v), fmt(w$hi_v)),
             "Lost, % of P* (95% CI)" = sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", fmt(100 * w$est_buffer_used, 0),
                                                fmt(100 * w$lo_buffer_used, 0), fmt(100 * w$hi_buffer_used, 0)))
xpos <- c(0, 0.22, 0.56)
tab <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(cols), function(i) data.frame(guild = w$guild, x = xpos[i], txt = cols[[i]])))
p2 <- ggplot(tab, aes(x, guild, label = txt)) +
  geom_text(hjust = 0, size = 3.1) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = xpos, labels = names(cols), position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x.top = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 9, margin = margin(b = 4)))

(p1 + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(1.1, 1))) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Habitat lost to fire, by guild",
                  subtitle = "Levins model with habitat destruction: P = 1 \u2212 v \u2212 e/c",
                  caption = paste("Bar length = expected P without fire (P*); coloured = still occupied after the fire, grey = lost to fire (v).",
                                  "Error bar = 95% CI of the boundary (2,000 draws of the guild fire effect).",
                                  "Negative v = no loss. Detection rate is used as a proxy for occupancy.", sep = "\n"),
                  theme = theme_fp + theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8, colour = "grey30")))
```
